interpretation: The same 4B model can choose all six appropriate anchors under this short semantic-only English task.
A native grammar-constrained call can produce the same non-center labels as the unconstrained call; this small schema does not force all-center output.

This supports investigating anchor selection in a semantic planning pass and locking those model-selected values during geometry generation. It does not validate that architecture or change production.

This does not isolate which difference from the long geometry task caused all-center output: task composition, prompt language/length, schema complexity and other context still differ. It does not fully exonerate every full-schema code path.
